"Perl 5.36.3 and 5.38.2, threaded and unthreaded, each execute scalar and container consumers. Ordinary-source acceptance is not inferred.",
        "The new hosted relocation reports cover reviewed Array/List/Option Fin only. Earlier scalar evidence remains unchanged; fresh scalar relocation and reviewed Subtype require separate acceptance."

The [installed refinement checks](../evidence/perl-refinements-20261009.md) cover container `Fin` on ordinary-source and reviewed-IR packages in all four pinned Perl configurations. They include a full rerun after moving the installed package. The separate top-level scalar relocation gate is not part of that evidence.

Ordinary-source packages have [installed checks](../evidence/perl-refinements-20261009.md) for `String`, `Nat`, `Int`, `ByteArray` and `UInt32` on Perl 5.36.3 and 5.38.2, threaded and unthreaded. These checks include rejection, normalization, recovery and a full rerun after moving the installed package. Reviewed-IR Subtype remains separate work.
